title: Jailer 2 First Indian Film to Cross Rs 75 Crore in All Four South Markets
excerpt: Rajinikanth's sequel completed the milestone in Kerala on its 16th day, finishing a four-market run that eluded Baahubali 2, KGF Chapter 2 and Pushpa 2, according to Sacnilk.
body:
• Jailer 2, the Tamil-language Rajinikanth starrer directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, has become the first Indian film to gross over Rs 75 crore individually in each of the four major South Indian markets, according to Sacnilk.
  • Kerala was the last market to cross, reaching Rs 75.20 crore on day 16; the four markets together contributed Rs 454.75 crore, 89.3% of the film's Rs 509.45 crore India gross in Sacnilk's state-wise report.
  • In Kerala the film passed Baahubali 2's Rs 72.25 crore on day 13, ending a nine-year run as the state's highest-grossing non-Malayalam film.
  • Worldwide, Sacnilk puts the film at Rs 776.95 crore after 16 days, including Rs 267.50 crore overseas. Box-office figures are trade estimates and trackers differ.

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has done something none of Indian cinema's biggest blockbusters managed. According to Sacnilk's state-wise collection report, the Tamil-language film has crossed Rs 75 crore gross individually in Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, Karnataka, and Kerala — the first Indian film to clear that mark in all four southern markets.

The numbers, market by market

In Sacnilk's 16-day figures, Tamil Nadu contributed Rs 198.70 crore, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana Rs 92.85 crore, Karnataka Rs 88.00 crore and Kerala Rs 75.20 crore. The four markets total Rs 454.75 crore — about 89.3% of the film's Rs 509.45 crore India gross — with the rest of India adding Rs 54.70 crore. 123Telugu, reporting the same milestone, noted the film was inching towards Rs 800 crore worldwide.

"The numbers, market by market In Sacnilk's 16-day figures, Tamil Nadu contributed Rs 198.70 crore, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana Rs 92.85 crore, Karnataka Rs 88.00 crore and Kerala Rs 75.20 crore."

The comparison is what makes the record unusual. Baahubali 2 finished its Kerala run at about Rs 72.25 crore and KGF Chapter 2 at about Rs 64.98 crore in the state, Sacnilk reported, while Pushpa 2 built its totals on the Telugu states and the Hindi belt without comparable Kerala business. Each of those films posted higher headline numbers somewhere; none spread Rs 75 crore across all four southern territories.

Why Kerala decided it

Kerala, with its strong Malayalam industry, is the hardest of the four markets for an outside-language release. For nearly nine years Baahubali 2 held the record for the highest-grossing non-Malayalam film in the state. Jailer 2 passed that mark on day 13 and crossed Rs 75 crore on day 16; in Kerala alone, Sacnilk said, the sequel has already exceeded the original Jailer's lifetime gross by about 37%. Sacnilk credited part of the cross-market pull to casting: Mohanlal's presence connects with Malayalam audiences, Shivarajkumar's with Karnataka, on top of the first film's popularity.

The film and the run

Jailer 2 is produced by Sun Pictures and directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, with music by Anirudh Ravichander. Alongside Rajinikanth, 123Telugu lists Vidya Balan, SJ Suryah, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Mithun Chakraborty, Ramya Krishnan, Mirnaa Menon and Namo Narayana in key roles, with cameos by Hrithik Roshan, Mohanlal, Vijay Sethupathi and Shiv Rajkumar.

The run is not over. Pinkvilla's tracker — which compiles its estimates separately and put the India total slightly lower, at Rs 497 crore — reported a Rs 10.50 crore third Saturday, a 70% jump on the previous day. On Sacnilk's count the worldwide total stood at Rs 776.95 crore after 16 days, including Rs 267.50 crore overseas. All box-office figures are trade estimates, not audited collections, and totals vary by tracker.
